note: One example per kind of gear, not a ranking. Prices are what each seller listed on the checked date, before shipping and tax, and are only used for the kit total shown under each budget; a kit may run a little over its heading. Edit by hand; re-check prices before each gift season.

items.name: LilyGO T-Deck Plus
items.what: Screen and keyboard in one: messages with no phone. Needs firmware put on it first.

items.name: Heltec Mesh Node T096
items.what: A small board for a home repeater, or a companion paired to a phone. No case or battery in the box.

groups.name: Ham radio
groups.licence: Listening is open to anyone. Transmitting needs an amateur licence.

items.name: Baofeng MINI-5 (two radios)
items.what: A pair of first handhelds for 2 m and 70 cm. They charge over USB-C and also hear airband and weather radio.

items.name: Baofeng DM-1701
items.what: A DMR handheld that can run open firmware. Needs a DMR ID and a programmed channel list.

items.name: HF Signals sBitx v3
items.what: An open-source desk radio for the HF bands, the ones that reach across the country, with a Raspberry Pi inside. Needs a General licence, an 11.1 V battery or supply, and an antenna.

groups.name: GMRS
groups.licence: One FCC licence, no test, covers a household.

items.name: Baofeng UV-5G Plus
items.what: A handheld already set to the GMRS channels.

items.name: Radioddity DB20-G
items.what: A mobile radio for the car that plugs into the 12 V socket. Needs a vehicle antenna, sold separately.

items.name: RTL-SDR Blog V4L with antenna kit
items.what: A USB receiver that turns a computer into a scanner for most of what is on the air.

items.name: muzi works 17 cm whip
items.what: A 915 MHz whip for a handheld mesh radio, in place of the stock stub. SMA male.

items.name: SignalStick
items.what: A flexible whip for 2 m and 70 cm handhelds. Comes in three connector types; most Baofeng handhelds take SMA female.

items.name: Alientek T80 soldering iron
items.what: A pen-size iron that runs from a USB-C charger.

items.name: Soleilwear precision electric screwdriver
items.what: A small rechargeable driver with a set of bits for opening radios and cases.
